Description - HEAD /File.aspx

Not used by the client. Live probe: HEAD is not supported by the file server and answers 302 to /Error404.aspx?aspxerrorpath=/File.aspx. Use GET with Range: bytes=0-0 to probe a file.

Path notes

The signed URL returned by Download (FileEntry/url) and RefreshFileUrl (url): http://sNNNN.chomikuj.pl/File.aspx?e=…&pv=…. The client never builds it; it uses the URL verbatim.

Parameters

Client vs live - discrepancies

Security notes - findings that concern HEAD /File.aspx

  • S-08 Low Signed File.aspx?e=…&pv=… download URLs are reusable bearer URLs (repeat GET and Range work); expire was always empty, so their lifetime is unknown.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
